titre: Graphisoft launches AI plugin for Archicad that generates facade layouts
resume: The new AI assistant is now available as a plugin and uses generative design to propose facade options, reducing design time and carbon impact for architects.

titre: Graphisoft releases AI facade layout plugin for Archicad
resume: Available now: an AI plugin for Archicad generating facade layouts with generative design, cutting design time for architects.

titre: Reinforcement learning for autonomous excavator scheduling on construction sites
resume: This paper presents a novel framework using deep learning and robot control to schedule autonomous excavators on a construction site; simulation shows productivity gains.

titre: Digital twin and predictive maintenance pilot cuts building energy use
resume: A pilot project deploys a digital twin with machine learning for predictive maintenance in a commercial building, with energy monitoring and cost reduction of 18%.

titre: Machine learning predicts concrete strength for 3D printing of structures
resume: Researchers use machine learning to predict concrete mix strength for 3D printing in construction, improving structural safety and reducing carbon.

titre: Why architects are skeptical of AI-generated renderings
resume: An opinion piece on artificial intelligence rendering tools and their limits in architecture practice.

titre: Ten Scandinavian houses with timber facades
resume: A gallery of residential architecture projects using wood.

titre: Computer vision for construction site safety: detecting missing helmets with drones
resume: We propose a computer vision model deployed on drones for construction site safety monitoring; evaluated on a new dataset.
